scope: Complete B. subtilis five-method comparison; inventory existing six-species coverage; no new model tuning
robustness: MEME and STREME dinucleotide-null discovery pools are separate robustness views, not substitutes selected by Development performance
ranking: Discovery positive minus natural-control leakage-group presence; ties by descending information then candidate ID
threshold: Per-PWM maximum dual-strand sequence log-odds score on Discovery natural controls: numpy.quantile(q=0.9, method=higher); strict greater-than
background: The same complement-symmetric zero-order Discovery natural-control background for every PWM during common evaluation
family_hit: At least one selected candidate hit per sequence, OR within leakage group; mixed-label groups excluded for natural positive-negative comparison; shuffle remains paired by positive leakage group
similarity: Descriptive best centered cosine across offset and both orientations; overlap at least max(5,ceil(0.6*shorter PWM)); report overlap, offset and orientation
positions: Same scanner on Development for all methods; each PWM contributes at most one best site per sequence, then the highest-score site per leakage group; center relative to TSS index61; descriptive only
selection_for_figures: First three candidates in locked Discovery ranking for every run; show both preselected algorithm seeds; never select by Development outcome
stop_rule: Stop after fixed-parameter MEME recovery/rerun and common scan/report verification, regardless of method ranking; no further CNN/BERT fits
limits: Development was already observed: retrospective exploration
CNN uses sequence-level positive-negative supervision; supervision budgets and candidate generators differ
Two algorithm seeds share the same dataset and are repeated algorithm runs
MEME/STREME native E/p values are not common performance measures
The new common-scan threshold is not FIMO p or q; historical strict FIMO remains unchanged
20261003 MEME pools used full data including present Development and Holdout; historical display only, excluded from common comparison
Five-method completeness applies to B. subtilis; the other five species have an explicit coverage inventory
